historySource.indexText: George Washington, then 22 years old, were defeated here in the opening battle of the French and Indian War on July 3, 1754. Established as a national battlefield site March 4, 1931; transferred from War Dept. Aug. 10, 1933; redesignated Aug. 10, 1961. Boundary change: Oct. 26, 1974.
